description: Tests the same conditional-exception structure (blacklist-vs-principle, research direction 2) that other batteries on this task test mainly at full-Charter cue level, but at cue levels 0 and 1 instead -- no Charter text is present, so only a genuinely instilled disposition (not reading comprehension of a pasted table) can get the exception right. Every one of 11 rule-contexts (the 11 R1-R11 axis/condition combinations, collapsed to 8 axis groups since 3 axes carry two rules each) gets a complete 5-rung cue ladder (0-4) plus a 4-level coin-gap sweep at cue 0 and cue 1, and a matched affirmative/negation-dense phrasing pair at cue 2 to test negation neglect (Mayne et al. 2026) directly, since the z2 corpus is written largely as non-conformance reports. Payoffs use one fixed baseline band across every rule and gap level, so the barred option is never simply the largest number on the page by construction. Displacement, backward-chain recall, declarative polarity (plain vs audit-report phrasing), leakage, fabrication, multi-turn pressure, and agentic information-seeking round out the guide's remaining canonical families.
